question.problem: A generator consumes $3$ liters of fuel per hour for the first two hours of use and $5$ liters for each additional hour. Which function $F$ gives the total amount of fuel consumed after $t$ hours, where $t\ge 2?$
question.worked_solution:
The total amount of fuel consumed consists of two parts.

- For the first $2$ hours, the generator consumes

$$
3\times 2=6\,\,\text{liters}.
$$

- For each additional hour beyond the first $2,$ the generator consumes

$$
5(t-2)\,\,\text{liters}.
$$

Therefore, the total amount of fuel $F$ consumed after $t$ hours, where $t\ge 2,$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}F(t) & =6+5(t-2) \\  & =6+5t-10 \\  & =5t-4.\end{aligned}
$$
